page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports AVX and AVX512F instruction sets. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge demonstrates mixed performance profiles. Its CPU and memory capabilities generally fall into the lower tiers, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU metrics, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores, placing in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory read bandwidth is also relatively low, though large block write bandwidth achieves average tier performance at 34.64 GB/sec. The instance shows average capabilities in Redis SET operations, processing 5.91 million operations per second, and performs adequately on small-scale LLM inference tasks, though performance drops significantly when handling medium-sized models.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer a predictable environment for workloads that do not require high-performance computing or local NVMe storage. Given the CPU and memory read benchmarks, this instance is best suited for moderate general-purpose workloads, such as lightweight web serving, basic Redis caching, small-scale application hosting, and entry-level data processing tasks where extreme throughput is not a primary requirement.
